statement: 灯光权威采用证据校准后的高调白棚商业摄影：白背景只作为背景与受控环境，不作为主体主光；主体由远距超大柔光和反射层建模，金属由连续白/银渐变反射出层次，镜面球体不得反射可读灯具、黑旗、近距发光板或周边产品部件。

lighting_state.studio_environment: white cyclorama or white cloth environment with separated subject lighting
lighting_state.background_role: camera background and low-intensity white environment only
lighting_state.subject_light_role: independent far large diffused sources and bounce surfaces for valve form modeling
lighting_state.reflection_environment_role: continuous white and soft silver gradients for stainless readability

lighting_layers.purpose: 保持商业白棚和干净首页背景；不得承担主体主光，不得用大面积正面平行白光洗平阀体阴影纹理。
用远距、超大、扩散后的左右上方主光和轮廓光塑造阀体体块、法兰边缘和不锈钢高光层次。
底部两侧和正面只做柔和补光，抬亮下缘与孔腔可读性，不形成硬影、白斑或灯具形状。
为金属和抛光球体提供连续白/银渐变反射；该层可以被 glossy 看到，但不能被相机读成摄影棚设备。
通过 ray visibility 和对象可见性隔离，防止灯具、反光板、黑旗和非球体产品部件在抛光球体上形成可读反射。

roles.purpose: main far large diffused modeling highlight from upper left; not a readable panel reflection
controlled upper right stainless edge definition; not a hard light stripe
lift lower stainless surfaces softly without hard underside glare
balance lower stainless surfaces without black studio falloff
soft front visibility fill; not a camera-readable or glossy-readable panel
low-intensity white environmental floor only; never the primary subject exposure

subject_light_policy.softness_definition: softness is controlled by large apparent source size, diffusion and reflection angle, not by distance alone
subject_light_policy.far_soft_source_requirement: if a light is moved farther away, its emitting or diffusing surface must remain large enough to read as broad soft light on the valve
subject_light_policy.metal_form_priority: lighting must preserve cast body shadow texture, flange depth, bore darkness and edge separation

polished_ball_allowed_reflection_sources: the ball core own bore and edge depth

white_background_and_cards.camera_visibility: allowed only when used as background, not as readable equipment

forbidden: black or dark-grey studio as the dominant background
white background used as the primary subject key light
white world light used as the primary subject exposure
large parallel front wash that flattens cast body shadow texture
overbright background spill that washes the stainless body grey
camera-readable light equipment reflected on polished ball
readable surrounding product parts reflected on polished ball
left or right valve body reflection readable on polished ball
seat, stem, bracket, fastener or spring reflection readable on polished ball
black-flag reflection pollution in approved release lookdev
reflection-card shapes readable as equipment on stainless body or ball
hard white blotch highlights on product-facing stainless body
overexposed white emitter panels inside the product composition
close light sources that read as equipment rather than soft studio reflection
